'''Dune ghosts''' were part of the local legends of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorians]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], who believed that dune ghosts wandered the [[Desert/Legends|wastelands]] of the world at [[Standard day/Legends|night]]. Combined with legends of disappearing travelers, the fear of dune ghosts led Zalorians to avoid the open deserts, congregating instead in small outposts connected by frequently used roads.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dune ghosts were mentioned in the DataBank entry for Zaloriis in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
